name: BCP
description:
Fabric Data Warehouse will support the bcp utility and the TDS Bulk Load API, enabling high-performance data ingestion from a variety of client tools such as bcp, SSIS, and Azure Data Factory. This integration simplifies bulk data loading into Fabric DW and supports scalable, efficient workflows. Centralized support for these APIs ensures consistency across ingestion pipelines and improves interoperability with existing tools.
An example of a bcp command that loads file content into a DW table:
```bcp dbo.artists in gold_artist.txt -d TextDW -c -S myworkspace.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com -G -U theuser@microsoft.com ```
